lessons.correction: Maintain economy and expansion, strengthen ground, continue tech, develop with safety checks.
lessons.mistake: Overcommitting to army before economy is stable.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when opponent posture becomes clearer or at next timing.
lessons.title: Balance economy and safety in early game
lessons.when: Early game, opponent posture unknown, own ground-oriented with Queens.
lessons.why: Establish a solid economic and tech foundation while staying safe against early pressure.

lessons.correction: Continue economy, increase tech, strengthen ground.
lessons.mistake: Falling behind in army strength while teching.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when tech completes or opponent changes.
lessons.title: Tech up to counter Terran ground threats
lessons.when: Early-midgame, opponent ground with Marines, Reapers, Hellions, own ground with Zerglings, Queens, moderate tech.
lessons.why: Tech up to handle Terran ground threats.

lessons.correction: Increase air, strengthen air, continue economy, increase upgrades.
lessons.mistake: Overcommitting to air without ground support.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when opponent tech or army composition changes.
lessons.title: Use Mutalisks for harassment and map control
lessons.when: Midgame, opponent ground with Marines, Ghosts, Hellions, Medivacs, own ground with Zerglings, Mutalisks, Queens, Overseers.
lessons.why: Use Mutalisks for harassment and map control.
